name: Herkules S.A.
summary: Headquartered in Warsaw, Poland, Herkules S.A. primarily operates in the rental of heavy lifting equipment and the transport of oversized loads throughout Poland. The company maintains a diverse fleet of cranes, including tower, field, self-propelled, and tracked models, complemented by engineering, operator, and technical consulting services. Beyond equipment rental, Herkules provides construction and assembly expertise for a wide range of projects, from general structures to wind farms, telecommunications networks, and energy installations. They also engage in manufacturing, producing electrical pylons, reinforced concrete containers, and pre-stressed concrete masts used in the energy, telecommunications, and advertising industries. Additional services encompass general construction, assembly, and electrical work, as well as the specialized installation of wind farm equipment and road-based transport for exceptionally large cargo. Furthermore, Herkules produces a variety of concrete, cement, and plaster products. The company was previously known as Gastel Zurawie S.A. before rebranding as Herkules S.A. in December 2011.
